evals.prompt: Write a specification for the invoice export tool in billing-api. It reads paid invoices from Postgres, renders them as PDF, and uploads them to object storage once a night.
evals.expected_output: A new file spec/spec-tool-invoice-export.md that follows the eleven-section template with numbered requirements and acceptance criteria.
expectations: A file is created under spec/ whose name matches spec-[a-z0-9-]+.md and starts with one of schema, tool, data, infrastructure, process, architecture, or design
The file begins with YAML front matter containing title and date_created
The file contains the headings '## 1. Purpose & Scope' through '## 11. Related Specifications / Further Reading' in order
Section 3 lists requirements with REQ-NNN identifiers and section 5 lists acceptance criteria with AC-NNN identifiers
Section 2 defines every acronym used in the document, including PDF

evals.expected_output: The agent asks what the specification is for before writing anything, or states the assumed purpose in one line and proceeds.
expectations: No file is written under spec/ before the purpose of the specification is known or explicitly assumed
The transcript either asks the user for the specification purpose or states the assumed purpose in one sentence
If a file is written, its name still matches spec-[a-z0-9-]+.md and starts with a valid purpose prefix

evals.prompt: We already have spec/spec-schema-customer-record.md in web-app. Write a specification for the audit log schema that extends it; the audit log must not store personal data in plain text.
evals.expected_output: A new file spec/spec-schema-audit-log.md that references the existing customer record spec and captures the no-plain-text constraint as a security requirement.
expectations: A new file is created under spec/ with a name starting with spec-schema- and the existing spec-schema-customer-record.md is not overwritten
Section 3 contains a SEC-NNN or CON-NNN identifier that states personal data must not be stored in plain text
Section 4 describes the audit log data contract with a table or code block
